==Usage==
*This is to be used in out-of-universe articles such as films, TV shows, video games, and audio dramas.
*It is recommended that you leave a space between the parameters, to allow for better legibility of long lists and distinguishing between different sections.
*To add multiple columns to a section, add <code><nowiki>{{!}}</nowiki></code> on a line by itself where you want the column break to be.

<pre style="width:45%; float:left">
==Credits==
{{Credits
|cast=
|uncreditedcast=
|crew=
|uncreditedcrew=
|specialthanks=
}}
</pre>
{{Clear}}

==Credits==
{{Credits
|cast=*[[Mark Hamill]] as [[Luke Skywalker]]
*[[Harrison Ford]] as [[Han Solo]]
*[[Carrie Fisher]] as [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Princess Leia]]
|uncreditedcast=[[James Earl Jones]] as the voice of [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]]
|crew=Director: [[George Lucas]]
|uncreditedcrew=Laugh technician: [[Salacious B. Crumb]]
|specialthanks=*[[Pablo Hidalgo]]
*[[Wookieepedia]]
}}
